features: 18 deterministic numeric equation features appended to existing representations/statistics
selection: three-fold question-disjoint training OOF accuracy, seed 2026; original baseline wins ties
validation: evaluate the selected configuration once; no validation search
robustness: After selection, compare the winner and original in three reshuffled train-only folds (seed 2037); diagnostic only, no reselection
test: Do not open public test inputs or references in this round
scaler: fit within each training fold; refit on train only after model selection
parser: bounded AST numeric evaluator with unit/unknown-expression rejection; arithmetic consistency only, not logical correctness
